mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates by signaling accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it triggers central bank tightening expectations that depress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY inflation exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signal robust consumer demand and labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and PAYEMS fails to predict positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), rising unemployment signals economic weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 3-month moving average indicates weakening supply chain activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without additional triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is below its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1250 thousand units, it signals strong consumer demand for housing, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1250.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal aggressive monetary tightening amid persistent inflation, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: In strong consumer spending regimes (RSAFS > 450,000 million dollars), rising retail sales and food services (RSAFS) signal robust economic activity that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS > 450000.
